Sandbox_HARMONIE_ModernFirearmsSystemFix: Multiplies how often this mod's own ~230 guns and ammo items appear in loot, on top of the mod's own hardcoded weights (it ships with no rate control of its own, only per-gun on/off toggles). 1.0 = the mod's own unmodified rate. 0 = never spawns (same as disabling every per-gun toggle). Does not affect vanilla loot or this mod's weapon attachments/parts.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixAttachmentLoot: Mercenary Is Life 3 - Firearm and Attachment Loot
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGunRates: Mercenary Is Life 2 - Individual Firearm Rates (0 = Off, 1 = Default)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoot_EnableMFSCiv: Add All Mercenary Is Life Firearms to Civilian Firearm Locations
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoot_DisableVanil: Removes all eleven vanilla weapon-part items from newly generated procedural container loot. Mercenary Is Life attachments, existing items, attached parts, and crafted parts are unaffected.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoot_FirearmMulti: Loot-weight multiplier for firearms supplied by Mercenary Is Life. Individual gun spawn checkboxes still apply. 0 disables Mercenary Is Life firearms in new procedural loot; 1 keeps the authored rate.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoot_FunctionalMa: Loot-weight multiplier for usable Mercenary Is Life magazines and drums. Decorative magazine weapon parts are excluded. 0 disables this category; 1 keeps the authored rate.
Sandbox_ModernFirearmsSystemSandbox_Gun: Mercenary Is Life 1 - Firearm Spawn Switches (Off Removes Type from New Loot)
Sandbox_MFSSandbox_EnableReticle: Enable Mercenary Is Life Reticle System (Off = Vanilla Reticle)
